phase: PHASE 4 — QA fixes, security & production hardening

confirmedIssues.issue: Textbook page images were authorized by subject visibility only — a student with no paid entitlement and no active trial could fetch READY book pages (P2 in the original audit, raised to P0/P1 by Phase 4 requirements).
confirmedIssues.fix: lib/books/pages.ts now requires hasSubjectAccess (paid entitlement incl. bundle scope) OR an active/claimed, unexpired, non-exhausted trial for non-admin users.

verification.unit: new regression test: visible subject + no access => 404; ACTIVE/CLAIMED trial => 200; EXPIRED/EXHAUSTED => 404; entitlement => 200

confirmedIssues.issue: The Phase 3 platform-name setting did not surface on the landing page: app/page.tsx exported a hardcoded <title> that overrode the root layout template.
confirmedIssues.fix: Removed the hardcoded landing title so the root layout's admin-managed default applies.
confirmedIssues.verification: live check: setting platformName changed <title> to 'منصة الاختبار | معلّمك الذكي من كتابك' immediately; meta application-name updated too

confirmedIssues.issue: Production persistence gaps: scripts/backup.sh backed up only DATA_DIR/books (not admin-uploaded subject images), and deploy/env.production.example lacked SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
confirmedIssues.fix: backup.sh now archives DATA_DIR/uploads and prints the encryption-key backup warning; env example documents SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY; deploy/README documents uploads restore, key custody and the forward-only migration rollback strategy (restore DB backup + previous image).
confirmedIssues.verifiedExisting: deploy/docker-compose.production.yml already bind-mounts /data/fahimni (host) into both fahimni-web and fahimni-worker with DATA_DIR=/data/fahimni, so uploads/books survive rebuild, restart and update.

securityVerification.adminApis: every app/api/admin/**/route.ts uses authorizeAdminRequest (grep: zero exceptions); new settings routes covered by 403 student test
securityVerification.secretLeakage: encrypted settings never rendered (Phase 3 browser check); status endpoints expose booleans only
securityVerification.maliciousInput: page traversal/encoding rejected (404), upload magic-byte validation, whatsapp/offer/term form validation, same-origin CSRF on all writes
securityVerification.crossUser: entitlements resolved by session userId + subject scope; no route accepts an entitlement/plan id from the client
securityVerification.noCacheSettings: settings read from PostgreSQL per resolution — no stale secrets or values across processes

studentFlows.overflow: 0 pages with horizontal overflow across all four viewports
studentFlows.realAiCall: POST /api/tutor with real OpenAI key after the Phase 3 provider refactor -> 200 with real lesson (7.4s); retrieval no_context case refunds as designed
studentFlows.spaNavigation: client-side admin navigation keeps stylesheets (2) and sidebar styling; no stale CSS
studentFlows.serviceWorker: dev: no controller/registrations (disabled by design); production SW v2 verified in the original audit

billingSafety.multipleOffersPerUser: checkout duplicate guard blocks only the SAME offer; separate licenses/entitlements per purchase are supported (unique license id)
billingSafety.singleSubscriptionSetting: provider-side Freemius product setting; code does not restrict additional purchases — owner must allow multiple licenses in the Freemius dashboard (external)
billingSafety.bundleSharedWallet: unchanged, covered by existing wallet-policy tests
billingSafety.trialSeparate: unchanged, trial wallet never mixes with paid
billingSafety.forgedEntitlements: browser sends offerId only; plan/price/scope resolved server-side; webhook signature + idempotency unchanged
billingSafety.unverifiedPlanNeverReady: checkout + student picker + admin statuses require a verified provider link (Phase 3)

aiBudget.design: trial daily budget (per trial claims) + optional global daily budget (default 0 = unlimited, opt-in by the admin)
aiBudget.paidStudents: never blocked when the global budget is unset (regression assertion added)
aiBudget.failure: config errors fail closed with Arabic messages; provider failures refund credits (existing behavior)

new: global budget null (disabled) never blocks paid users

screenshots: qa/screenshots/phase4-regression/ (4: desktop dashboard/admin subjects, mobile dashboard/admin subscriptions)
remainingP2: Retrieval brittleness for paraphrased questions (422 no_context) — unchanged, documented
externalBlockers: Freemius developer-scope credentials for live plan creation
Real Google OAuth consent round-trip requires production domain
Real payment transaction test requires staging with live keys
cleanup: fixtures removed, dummy page image removed, no settings left behind (only pre-existing maxDevicesPerUser)
